# Verify rows

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-verify-rows.py from noo-cli/src/commands/cluster_verify/rows.rs; do not edit. -->

Every row `noo cluster verify` can print, and the few that `noo security
at-rest preflight-firmware` prints. `!` is a warning (the verb still
passes), `x` a failure (exit 1). A row's `id` is stable: programs key on it
(`noo --json cluster verify` prints it beside `name`, which may be
reworded); `id` is never null, and a null is a bug to report. Node rows
are under `nodes[].checks`, controller rows under
`controller.checks`.

## Node rows (one set per node)

| Row | id | Can be | Means | Clears when |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| agent address | `agent_address` | `x` | Whether the gateway accepted the address the node agent reported; if refused it dials a default address instead. | On the node set NODE_IP in /etc/noo-node-agent.env to its registered address (the remedy names it), then re-provision. |
| backend caps | `backend_caps` | `!` | Whether the extra container capabilities a node asked for for its inference backends are allowed; refused ones are dropped. | Edit NOO_BACKEND_CAP_ADD in /etc/noo-node-agent.env on the node to names from the allow-list. |
| backend doors | `backend_doors` | `!`, `x`, starting | Whether the node's inference backends are behind encrypted doors with valid, unexpired certificates and no refusals. | Run `noo cluster provision <node>` (add `--wait` for older agents); re-run if it says starting. |
| backend images | `backend_images` | `!`, `x` | Whether running backend containers use fixed images (pinned or versioned), not moving tags like latest. | Remove the floating container with `docker rm -f` on the node so it is recreated from the pinned image, or run `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` for older agents. |
| backend starts | `backend_starts` | `x` | Whether the node refused to start a backend and keeps refusing (for example a missing or quarantined model file). | Run the `noo cluster sync-model-files` command the reason names, else `noo cluster show <node>`. |
| boot partition | `boot_partition` | `!`, `x` | Whether the boot partition has room and an intact copy of the next-boot initrd so the node will reboot. | Follow the row's steps: pin a known-good boot entry, shrink and recopy the initrd, avoid apt and kernelstub; `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` if the agent is old. |
| bus | `bus` | `!`, `x`, starting | Whether the node is connected to the message bus on its own identity so jobs reach it. | Run `noo cluster provision <node>`; `noo cluster nats-creds rotate <node>` if it is on the wrong identity. |
| cert | `cert` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node's own certificate is not expired or about to expire. | Run `noo security pki issue-node <node> && noo cluster provision <node>`. |
| control over bus | `control_over_bus` | `!`, `x` | Whether the controller can reach the node's control calls over the message bus, not just over HTTPS. | Run `noo cluster nats-users render` then `noo cluster restart-agent <node>`; `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` for old agents. |
| data root | `data_root` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node's data root agrees across what the controller declared, what the agent runs on, and where its running containers mount data. | Make them agree: `noo cluster set-config <node> --data-root <path>` then `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`; warn: `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` for an older agent. |
| data root policy | `data_root_policy` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node's data root is a dedicated, conventional directory owned by the agent; fails once the node enforces the policy, else warns. | Fix the owner/permissions or declare the root, e.g. `noo cluster set-config <node> --data-root <path>` then `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`. |
| docker engine | `docker_engine` | `!` | Whether the node's Docker Engine is new enough (version 27 or later, the oldest noomesh tests) and readable. | Upgrade Docker Engine on the node to 27 or newer, then `noo cluster verify <node>`; for an unreadable engine check the daemon and socket. |
| door pin | `door_pin` | `!` | Whether each pinned backend door image the node runs is staged on the controller's image rail by its exact pinned digest. | Run `noo upgrade --stack` to restage door pins by digest, then verify again. |
| gpu | `gpu` | `!`, `x` | The node's GPU state: free, shared with other programs, yielded, held by a lease, or lost by the driver. | Fail (driver lost): reboot the node. Held: `noo cluster gpu release <node>` or `noo cluster gpu mode <node> mesh` when the other work is done; yielded resumes by itself. |
| gpu driver | `gpu_driver` | `!`, `x` | Whether the kernel the node boots next (and its fallback kernel) has the NVIDIA driver module, so the GPU still works after a reboot. | Install the NVIDIA module for that kernel or make the running kernel the fallback, as the node's kernel runbook says. |
| gpu target | `gpu_target` | `!` | Whether a model placed on the GPU is actually running on the CPU because the node cannot run the CUDA llama.cpp image. | `noo cluster place <node> <backend> <model> --on cpu`, or place it on ollama or vllm for a GPU. |
| hardened images | `hardened_images` | `x` | Whether the node runs an upstream backend image (ollama, llama.cpp) where noomesh ships its own hardened build. | Stage ours: `noo cluster sync-images <node> -i <hardened-ref>` (or restage by lock via `noo upgrade --stack`); unset any LLAMACPP_IMAGE/OLLAMA_IMAGE override. |
| harness | `harness` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node's agent harness runs as its declared policy says (running when wanted, stopped when off). | Check `noo cluster logs <node> harness`, or `noo cluster unplace <node> harness` when the policy is off. |
| harness egress | `harness_egress` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node's harness is firewalled off the internet (egress hold) and its hosts file is current. | Run `noo cluster provision <node>`; for an old agent `noo upgrade --all`. |
| harness tasks | `harness_tasks` | `!` | Whether the node's harness has a stalled task (no progress for 45 minutes) or tasks queued for over 30 minutes. | Look at `noo tasks list`; the harness releases a stalled task itself, a queue clears as slots free. |
| holds | `holds` | `!` | Whether the platform packages (kernel, NVIDIA driver and similar) are held so an ordinary apt upgrade cannot move them. | Apply the package hold command in the node's kernel runbook. |
| host telemetry | `host_telemetry` | `!`, `x` | Whether tailscaled uploads its logs to Tailscale or Ubuntu reporters (motd-news, popularity-contest, whoopsie) are on; log upload fails, reporters warn. | Run `noo cluster host-telemetry apply <node>` for tailscaled; disable each named Ubuntu reporter with the printed command. |
| hostd | `hostd` | `!`, `x`, starting | Whether noo-hostd, the privileged helper every node host operation needs, is alive. | Run `noo cluster provision <node>` to ship the helper (`--wait` for an old agent). |
| image sources | `image_sources` | `!` | Whether every image the node runs came from the controller's image rail rather than local or a public registry. | Stage it: `noo cluster sync-images <node> -i <image>`; the agent takes the rail copy on its next start. |
| images staged | `images_staged` | `!` | Whether every image placed on the node is staged on the controller's rail for the node's architecture. | Run `noo cluster sync-images <node> -i <image>` or `noo upgrade` for release images. |
| inbound | `inbound` | `!`, `x` | Whether the controller can reach the node agent over the network. | Check `noo cluster show <node>` for its address and the tailnet grant; a node reached over its bus is OK. |
| lanes | `lanes` | `!` | Whether each chat model lane the node's agent reports is serving or on demand, i.e. routable. | Look at `noo cluster show <node>`; start or place the named lane. |
| llamacpp offload | `llamacpp_offload` | `!` | Whether a llama.cpp model placed on the GPU actually offloaded its layers to the GPU rather than running on the CPU. | Update the NVIDIA driver on the node (CUDA 12.9 build needs 575+), or `noo cluster place <node> llamacpp <model> --on cpu`. |
| log shipper | `log_shipper` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node is sending its container and host logs to the controller, and not stuck with a backlog. | Enable with NOO_LOG_SHIP=1 in /etc/noo-node-agent.env and restart the agent, or `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`; `noo upgrade --stack` for an old gateway. |
| model stores | `model_stores` | `!` | Whether any of the node's model stores is writable by every account on the machine (anyone could plant model files). | Run the printed `sudo chmod o-w <path>` on that node. |
| next boot | `next_boot` | `!` | Whether the node's next reboot will start the kernel it is running now, not an untested newer one. | Boot the new kernel on a canary first; see docs/operating/runbooks/host-updates.md. Informational on WSL2. |
| node-local | `node_local` | `!` | Whether the node's own declarations file (kept across upgrades) is accepted, with every declaration in effect. | Fix the file on the node (root-owned, mode 644, valid keys) and restart the node agent. |
| ollama models | `ollama_models` | `!`, `x` | Whether each Ollama model on the node matches the controller's record of it, so the weights served are the controller's. | Re-pull through noo: `noo models pull <model>` on the controller's own node, else `noo models fetch ollama:<tag>` then `noo cluster import-model <node> ollama:<tag>`. |
| online | `online` | `!`, `x`, starting | Whether the node is online and has sent a heartbeat recently. | Check `noo cluster logs <node>` / `noo cluster show <node>`; `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` if its beats are refused; starting clears with `noo cluster verify --wait`. |
| peer identity | `peer_identity` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node agent demands a client certificate on its control API. | `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`. |
| sidecar image | `sidecar_image` | `!` | Which image the node's backend-door stunnel sidecars run on; the alpine fallback means each start installs stunnel from a mirror. | `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` so the node gets the published stunnel image. |
| signing | `signing` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node has adopted the fleet signing key, which it needs to accept signed updates. | `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`; the node adopts the key when it applies the bundle. |
| streaming over tunnel | `streaming_over_tunnel` | `!`, `x` | Whether streaming calls to the node work over its control tunnel. | Warn: `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` or check `noo cluster logs <node>`; fail: read `noo cluster logs <node>`, the node reconnects on its own. |
| tailnet control | `tailnet_control` | `x`, starting | Whether the node's Tailscale is connected to its control plane; just after boot it reads 'starting'. | Wait a minute and re-run `noo cluster verify <node>`; if still failing, restart tailscaled on the node. |
| vendor telemetry | `vendor_telemetry` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node's backend containers have their vendor telemetry switches set, so no vendor phones home. | `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`; orphan containers are removed with `docker rm -f`. |
| version | `version` | `!`, `x`, starting | Whether the node agent's version matches the controller's release. | `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`. |
| vllm compute | `vllm_compute` | `!`, `x` | Whether a node with vLLM placed has a GPU new enough for vLLM's compute floor. | `noo cluster unplace <node> <backend>`, then place the model on ollama or llamacpp; or `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` if capability is unknown. |

## Controller rows (`--controller`, run on the controller)

| Row | id | Can be | Means | Clears when |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| add-on access | `add_on_access` | `!` | Whether each add-on's features suggested for users or operators are actually enabled for them, and the access settings could be read. | Run `noo addons accept-suggestions <addon>` or `noo addons set-access <addon> <feature> on --role <role>`; `noo addons features <addon>` shows state. |
| add-on console paths | `add_on_console_paths` | `!`, `x` | Whether the gateway accepted every add-on's console web path, or refused one (for example a path collision). | Fix the add-on's signed console path claim and restart the gateway; `noo health` shows the refusals. |
| add-on containers | `add_on_containers` | `!`, `x` | Whether the containers each enabled add-on declares are running (for example after a reboot). | Run `noo stack restart <addon>`. |
| add-on pins | `add_on_pins` | `!`, `x` | Whether every enabled add-on's pinned image verifies against the signed release; an unverified add-on is left out of every start. | Run `noo addons upgrade`; `noo addons verify` shows which add-on fails (`noo addons list` if the enabled set is unknown). |
| age key at rest | `age_key_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the SOPS age key (which decrypts every secret) is protected on disk: sealed to the TPM and live only in RAM, or on an encrypted disk. | Run `noo security at-rest seal` (then `noo security at-rest finalize` after a reboot and a fresh backup), or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out`. |
| agent certificate | `agent_certificate` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node agent's TLS certificate covers the address the controller dials, and no other node claims that address. | Re-issue the node's certificate with `noo security pki push-nodes <node>`. |
| agent credential | `agent_credential` | `!` | Whether the gateway has a credential node agents accept: nodes must report controller_leaf_only, or a shared token must be configured. | Run `noo upgrade --nodes` or `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`. |
| agent mail | `agent_mail` | `!` | Whether unread agent mail is stuck in mailboxes that were retired. | Read it with `noo_agent_inbox orphaned=true` through an MCP door. |
| agent metrics | `agent_metrics` | `!` | Whether Prometheus is scraping every registered node agent. | Fix the cause named (a certificate with no address: `noo security pki issue-node <node> <host>`), or wait a minute for the scrape list. |
| agent protect | `agent_protect` | `!`, `x` | Whether each Linux node agent runs held to only the filesystem paths it must write. | Run `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`; for a refused setting fix that setting on the node, then provision. |
| at-rest outside the set | `at_rest_outside_the_set` | `!`, accepted | Whether other places holding sensitive text (some docker volumes, docker logs, journald) sit on an encrypted disk. | Informational: these places have no encryption step of their own yet; record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out`. |
| at-rest pcr binding | `at_rest_pcr_binding` | `!` | Whether the TPM-sealed age key is bound to Secure Boot and that state still matches, so the next boot can unseal it. | Run `noo security at-rest seal`; turn Secure Boot on first if it is off. |
| at-rest recovery key | `at_rest_recovery_key` | `!` | Whether the encrypted state volume has a recovery key that was confirmed stored off this machine. | Run `noo security at-rest recovery-key`, store the new key off the machine and acknowledge it. |
| at-rest swap | `at_rest_swap` | `!` | Whether swap could write secrets from memory to an unencrypted disk. | Use zram or encrypted swap, or turn swap off (`sudo swapoff -a` and remove it from /etc/fstab). |
| at-rest tpm | `at_rest_tpm` | `!` | Whether this machine has a usable TPM 2.0 and the tools needed to seal keys and encrypt state at rest. | Install the missing tools or follow the hint in the row; no TPM means nothing can clear it. |
| at-rest volume | `at_rest_volume` | `!`, `x`, accepted | Whether the controller's state lives on an encrypted (LUKS) volume that is open, mounted and actually holding the state. | Run `noo security at-rest create-volume`, then `noo security at-rest migrate --dry-run`; if the volume is down, `systemctl status` its cryptsetup unit. |
| at-rest volume binding | `at_rest_volume_binding` | `!`, `x` | Whether the encrypted state volume's TPM lock matches Secure Boot now: a mismatch means it will not unlock at next boot. | Run `noo security at-rest reenroll` (or `noo security at-rest reenroll --pcrs 7` to bind it to Secure Boot). |
| audit key | `audit_key` | `!`, `x` | Whether the audit signing key exists in the secret store; without it the gateway will not start. | Run `noo upgrade --stack` (it mints the key); `noo security secrets audit` if the store is unreadable. |
| audit log | `audit_log` | `!`, `x` | Whether the tamper-evident security audit log verifies, with no lost or stuck rows. | Run `noo security audit verify`; if the key is missing `noo upgrade --stack`. |
| backend tls | `backend_tls` | `!`, `x` | Whether every inference backend in the shipped compose file sits behind an encrypted door that demands a client certificate and publishes no open port. | Run `noo upgrade --stack` to restore the shipped compose file and stunnel configs. |
| callers | `callers` | `!`, `x` | Whether every client calling the gateway is a known tailnet device and none is looping on refusals. | Run `noo doctor strangers`. |
| cert expiry | `cert_expiry` | `!`, `x` | Whether every certificate under the PKI directory is still valid, not expired or due within 30 days. | Run `noo security pki rotate-all` (`noo security pki status` to list). |
| cloud gate | `cloud_gate` | `!`, `x` | Whether a stored cloud provider key is usable: the cloud routing switch must be on or chat to cloud models is refused. | Turn on Cloud model routing in the console Settings, or remove the key; `noo security secrets audit` if the store is unreadable. |
| companions | `companions` | `!` | Whether companion agents (sensors) run the same build as their host node's agent. | Run `noo cluster provision <host> --wait`. |
| config mount | `config_mount` | `!`, `x` | Whether every container sees the same noomesh.yaml as the host, so config changes are not silently lost. | Run `noo stack restart --force <service>` for the named services. |
| controller hf-cache hub owner | `controller_hf_cache_hub_owner` | `!` | Whether the controller compose's HF cache `hub` folder is owned like its parent, so model downloads can write to it. | Run the printed `sudo chown -R -P -h <uid>:<gid> <hub>` once at a terminal. |
| data at rest | `data_at_rest` | `!`, `x`, accepted | One summary row that folds the per-directory 'at rest' rows: which data directories sit unencrypted on disk (worst state shown). | Put the listed directories on an encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS) disk, or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out`; `--verbose` shows the per-directory rows. |
| data directories | `data_directories` | `!` | Whether every data directory the release's compose file mounts (under the data and state roots) exists on the controller. | Run `noo onboard --only storage`; when only the next release's new directories are missing, `noo upgrade --stack` creates them. |
| data root filesystem | `data_root_filesystem` | `!`, `x` | Whether the data root sits on the filesystem recorded for it, so a missing mount does not start Postgres empty. | Check `findmnt` and `lsblk -f` and the data-root recovery runbook; the next `noo stack start` records it. |
| default chat | `default_chat` | `!`, `x` | Where an unpinned chat request (model default/auto) goes right now, and whether any live chat model, GPU, or second node backs it. | Place a chat model on a node: `noo cluster place <node> <backend> <model>` (check with `noo cluster class list`). |
| docker userns | `docker_userns` | `!`, `x` | Whether Docker remaps container user ids (userns-remap), which would make services unable to read their private keys. | Remove "userns-remap" from /etc/docker/daemon.json, then `sudo systemctl restart docker`. |
| embedding spaces | `embedding_spaces` | `!`, `x` | Whether each embedding space has a live node serving its model; fails if the default space has none, warns on other gaps or migrations. | Inspect with `noo cluster embedding-space list`, then place or start the embedder the space needs. |
| entitlement | `entitlement` | `x` | Whether the installed entitlement (licence token) is present and valid when a licensed add-on is on. | Install a valid token with `noo security entitlement install <token>`, or inspect with `noo security entitlement show`. |
| erasure archive | `erasure_archive` | `!`, `x` | Whether the daily purge of archived user erasures is running, i.e. no archived copy is older than the 30-day window plus a day. | Check the purge with `noo logs search erasure_purge --since 2d` and fix why it is not running. |
| exposure | `exposure` | `!`, `x` | Whether published ports are limited to the tailnet or loopback, and that a reboot cannot break the tailnet binding. | Set NOO_BIND_MODE=tailnet in .env then `noo stack restart --force`; for the reboot case apply the `noo doctor` nonlocal-bind fix; read with `noo doctor exposure`. |
| gateway add-on | `gateway_add_on` | `!`, `x` | Whether each add-on enabled in noomesh.yaml was accepted and is running in the gateway, not refused. | Fix the add-on's manifest and run `noo addons check <bundle-dir>`; if just not started, `noo stack start`. |
| gateway add-on caller key | `gateway_add_on_caller_key` | `!`, `x` | Whether the gateway minted the key add-ons use to call it at start; without it add-on calls are refused with 401. | Run `noo stack restart gateway`. |
| gateway bus | `gateway_bus` | `!`, `x` | Whether the gateway is connected to the NATS message bus; without it dispatch, gossip and agent mail answer 503. | Make NATS run: `noo stack start` (check `noo stack status`); the gateway reconnects by itself. |
| gateway fds | `gateway_fds` | `!`, `x` | Whether the gateway's open file descriptors are far below its limit; a leak can leave it unable to read secrets or reach the database. | Warn: look at `noo stack logs gateway --tail 200`; fail: `noo stack restart gateway` and investigate the leak. |
| gateway pki view | `gateway_pki_view` | `!` | Whether the gateway mounts only the safe parts of the PKI directory and its public certificate copy matches nodes/ and services/ without private keys. | Run `noo upgrade --stack` for wide mounts, or `noo security pki fix-modes` to resync pki/public/. |
| gateway redis | `gateway_redis` | `!`, `x` | Whether the gateway is connected to Redis; without it jobs, rate limiting and the response cache run degraded. | Make Redis reachable and run `noo stack restart gateway`. |
| GPU services | `gpu_services` | `!`, `x` | Whether any stack container is stuck stopped because the GPU did not answer when it started. | Reboot the host, then `noo stack start`. |
| grafana at rest | `grafana_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether Grafana's database directory (users, sessions, dashboards) sits on an encrypted disk. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| grafana door | `grafana_door` | `!`, `x` | Whether Grafana is reached only through noomesh sign-in, over HTTPS, with its port not exposed wider than loopback or the tailnet. | `noo upgrade --stack` fixes most cases (`noo upgrade --all` for data sources, `noo stack restart --force` for a stale gateway). |
| grafana sso | `grafana_sso` | `!` | Whether the key pair that lets the console's Open Grafana sign in exists, is readable by the gateway, and is mounted into Grafana. | Run `noo security pki issue-sso-key` then `noo stack restart --force`; or `noo upgrade --stack` for the compose mount. |
| harness systemd | `harness_systemd` | `!` | Whether any node's last apply refused the harness unit because its systemd is older than 247, leaving it on its previous unit. | Upgrade systemd on the named node to 247 or newer. |
| hf-cache hub owner | `hf_cache_hub_owner` | `!` | Whether the self-node agent's HF cache `hub` folder is owned like its parent, so model downloads can write to it. | Usually the node's next apply fixes it; otherwise run the printed `sudo chown -R -P -h` command. |
| image family | `image_family` | `!`, `x` | Whether the stack's runtime containers run the expected image family as non-root with a readable key. | `noo upgrade --stack`; `noo security pki fix-modes` for key access; `noo upgrade` if NOO_BASE_REGISTRY is the old upstream one. |
| image retention | `image_retention` | `!` | Whether cleanup of superseded noomesh images on the controller is working: not blocked after a roll and Docker not refusing removals. | Informational; see the named blocker, a later roll or `noo upgrade` re-runs the cleanup. |
| kiosk labels | `kiosk_labels` | `!` | Whether the controller sends entity names to the kiosk display (a warning when on, so it is seen), or the setting cannot be read. | Turn it off with `noo kiosk labels off`; `noo kiosk labels status` to read it. |
| last backup | `last_backup` | `!`, `x` | How old the last good database backup is: warn past about a day, fail past two days. | Run `noo heartbeat run database_backup`, then `noo heartbeat history database_backup`. |
| legacy lanes | `legacy_lanes` | `!` | Whether any retired credential lane (old CLI, fleet secret, v1 tokens) is still being used or refused, over a stated time window. | Follow the named caller: e.g. `noo upgrade --all`, `noo upgrade --nodes`, `noo cluster provision <node> --wait` or `noo security service-key provision <consumer>`. |
| logs access | `logs_access` | `!`, `x` | Whether the controller's log-reading endpoints refuse anonymous callers. | Refusal (401/403) is OK; if open, `noo upgrade --stack`; if the gateway did not answer, check `noo health`. |
| logs last seen | `logs_last_seen` | `!`, `x` | Whether the controller has recently accepted logs from every online node. | Fix the node's shipper (see its `log shipper` row): `noo cluster verify <node>`, `noo cluster provision <node> --wait`. |
| loki | `loki` | `!`, `x`, starting | Whether the log store (Loki) is configured and ready for the gateway to query. | Issue its certificate `noo security pki issue-service loki`, `noo upgrade --stack`, then `noo stack restart --force loki`; inspect with `noo stack status` / `noo logs status`. |
| loki at rest | `loki_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the log store's data directory sits on an encrypted disk; logs are otherwise readable by anyone holding the drive. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| loki listener | `loki_listener` | `!`, `x` | Whether the log store only accepts callers with a cluster client certificate and publishes no host port. | Restore the shipped Loki config and compose file with `noo upgrade --stack`; remove any `ports:` block from the loki service. |
| metrics scrape | `metrics_scrape` | `!` | Whether Prometheus can scrape the controller's /metrics: mTLS enforcement on and all monitoring service certificates present. | Remove NOO_MTLS_GATEWAY=false from .env and `noo stack restart --force`, or `noo security pki issue-service <service>`. |
| model cache | `model_cache` | `!`, `x` | Whether the model-weight cache serves over mTLS only and every node can reach it. | Issue its certificate `noo security pki issue-service model-cache`, restore the shipped nginx/compose files, or `noo cluster provision <node>`. |
| model classes | `model_classes` | `!`, `x` | Whether every declared model class has at least one candidate model that is placed or available. | Place the missing model with `noo cluster place <node> <backend> <model>`; `noo cluster class list` shows the state. |
| model memory | `model_memory` | `!` | Whether models loaded on nodes stay within their memory estimate; names nodes whose measured use is over it. | Review with `noo cluster fit <node>`. |
| monitoring web config | `monitoring_web_config` | `!`, `x` | Whether every monitoring service that mounts a web-config file actually loads it, so its port needs TLS and a client certificate. | Restore the shipped file with `noo upgrade --stack`. |
| nats at rest | `nats_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the message bus data directory sits on an encrypted disk; queued tasks and mail are otherwise readable from the drive. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| nats principals | `nats_principals` | `!`, `x` | Whether every message-bus login is its own per-principal account, with no retired shared user or retired bridge setting. | `noo cluster nats-users render`; remove the retired setting via `noo security posture set NOO_NATS_LEGACY_SHARED_CREDS 0` and `noo stack restart gateway`. |
| nats tls | `nats_tls` | `!`, `x` | Whether the message bus accepts only mTLS connections, with no plaintext config or setting left. | Restore the shipped file with `noo upgrade --stack`. |
| netns restore | `netns_restore` | `!` | Whether the boot-restore unit that brings back containers sharing another's network is installed and enabled. | Install/enable the unit with the remedy the row prints (it varies by install, e.g. via the node's applier or one sudo line). |
| node-agent privilege | `node_agent_privilege` | `!`, `x` | Whether the node-agent container runs unprivileged, as the security posture says it should. | `noo security posture set NOO_NODE_AGENT_PRIVILEGED false`, or `noo security posture apply-profile hardened`. |
| noo-data at rest | `noo_data_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the gateway's data volume (uploads, artifacts, state) sits on an encrypted disk. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| noo-data bound | `noo_data_bound` | `!`, `x` | Whether the gateway's data volume lives under the chosen data root instead of docker's default volume store. | `noo onboard --only storage` for an unset data root; a FAIL means a bug, report it. |
| off-site backup | `off_site_backup` | `!`, `x`, accepted | Whether backups are copied off this machine, or the person deliberately chose not to. | `noo backups setup` to choose a destination; `noo backups status` if behind. |
| ollama slots | `ollama_slots` | `!` | On a CPU-only controller, whether the stack's Ollama runs one slot, which is faster and uses less cache. | Run `noo config set compose_env '{"OLLAMA_EMBED_NUM_PARALLEL":"1"}' && noo stack restart --force ollama-embed`. |
| pki at rest | `pki_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the cluster CA and service private keys sit on an encrypted disk. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| pki key modes | `pki_key_modes` | `!`, `x` | Whether every private key under the PKI directory is readable only by the account that needs it. | `noo security pki fix-modes` (run its printed sudo lines if any); `noo upgrade --stack` also repairs. |
| postgres at rest | `postgres_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the database files sit on an encrypted disk. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| postgres hba | `postgres_hba` | `!`, `x` | Whether the database accepts only TLS clients with a cluster certificate and a password, and the running service uses that policy. | Restore the shipped file with `noo upgrade --stack`. |
| postgres memory | `postgres_memory` | `!` | Whether the running Postgres was created with the memory sizes this install asks for. | `noo stack restart --force postgres` to recreate it. |
| postgres role identity | `postgres_role_identity` | `!`, `x` | Whether each database role has its own client certificate and the database requires it. | `noo upgrade --stack` (issues role certificates, refreshes the policy), `noo stack restart --force postgres`; or `noo onboard --only enrollment`. |
| postgres tls | `postgres_tls` | `!`, `x` | Whether a live test shows the database refusing clients with no certificate and plaintext connections. | Restore the shipped pg_hba.conf and recreate postgres (`noo stack restart --force`); `noo stack status` if the probe could not run. |
| posture | `posture` | `x` | Whether every security setting (gate) the running stack uses matches what was chosen, with no restart pending. | `noo stack restart --force`, then `noo security posture list`. |
| prometheus at rest | `prometheus_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the metrics database sits on an encrypted disk. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| provisioned add-ons | `provisioned_add_ons` | OK only | Lists add-ons whose database was set up but which are not switched on, so no services run for them. | Informational; switch the add-on on to start its services. |
| redis at rest | `redis_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether the Redis dumps (sessions, rate limits, caches) sit on an encrypted disk. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| release assets | `release_assets` | `!` | Whether the controller has cached every release file the nodes' bundles need for this version. | `noo upgrade --nodes`. |
| release check | `release_check` | `!`, `x` | Whether each node's updater installs root-level code only from a release-signed list, and none has refused a bundle. | `noo upgrade --all`; if a node is ahead of its controller, `noo upgrade --stack`. |
| restart loops | `restart_loops` | `!`, `x` | Whether any stack container keeps restarting in a loop. | `noo stack logs <service>` to find why, then fix and restart. |
| retired services | `retired_services` | `!`, `x` | Whether a container of a service the project retired as unsafe is still running. | Remove it with `docker rm -f <container>`; `noo doctor orphans` if the list could not be read. |
| sandbox executor | `sandbox_executor` | `!`, `x` | Whether sandboxed code runs under its own unprivileged user inside a working jail, never as the sandbox server. | `noo upgrade --stack`, `noo stack restart --force sandbox`, `noo stack logs sandbox`; the AppArmor case names `noo onboard --only services`. |
| sandbox listener | `sandbox_listener` | `!`, `x` | Whether the code-execution sandbox accepts only callers with a cluster certificate, no plain HTTP, and publishes no host port. | Restore the shipped compose file with `noo upgrade --stack`, then `noo stack restart --force sandbox`; for a leaf mismatch `noo security pki issue-service sandbox`. |
| secret files delivered | `secret_files_delivered` | `!` | Whether the secret files delivered to containers could be checked; names containers the audit did not check. | `noo security secrets audit`. |
| secrets | `secrets` | `x` | Whether every container that holds a shared secret agrees on its value. | Run `noo doctor secrets` and fix what it names. |
| secrets at rest | `secrets_at_rest` | `x` | Whether every secret lives in the encrypted store and `.env` holds none. | `noo onboard --reconfigure --only secrets --secrets-backend sops` then `noo security secrets tidy`; `tidy` alone if the store already has all. |
| secrets audit | `secrets_audit` | `!`, `x` | Whether the secrets audit finds any error in how secrets are stored and delivered. | Run `noo security secrets audit` and fix each error it lists. |
| secrets not in env | `secrets_not_in_env` | `!`, `x` | Whether any container holds a secret as a plain environment variable or leaves plaintext under secrets/. | Remedy depends on the finding (printed with the row); `noo stack status` if nothing is running. |
| self-agent lane | `self_agent_lane` | `x` | Whether the controller's own node is updated over the normal rail like every other node, not by a one-off sudo install. | `noo cluster provision <node>` for a sudo-lane install; `noo onboard --only services` if the node identity is incomplete. |
| service cert names | `service_cert_names` | `x` | Whether the certificates of services that remote nodes dial (nats, redis, postgres, model-cache) carry every name those nodes use. | Re-issue with `noo security pki issue-service <svc>`, then `noo stack restart --force <svc>`. |
| service keys | `service_keys` | `x` | Whether each service that needs its own key has an active one. | `noo security service-key provision <name>`, or `noo addons enable <name>` for an add-on. |
| service-key grants | `service_key_grants` | `!` | Whether each active service key carries every permission its service now declares; older keys may lack newer ones. | `noo security service-key provision <name>` to mint a key with the current permissions. |
| shared secrets | `shared_secrets` | `!`, `x` | Whether each secret is held only by its intended containers and every bus holder has its own distinct key. | `noo upgrade --stack`; warn: `noo addons upgrade trellion_intel`. |
| stack images | `stack_images` | `!`, `x` | Whether each running stack container runs exactly the image the release lock pins. | Run `noo upgrade --stack`; `noo stack status` if the check matched no container. |
| stack leftovers | `stack_leftovers` | `!` | Whether containers of a profile this stack does not run are still running. | Stop and remove them by name: `docker stop <name> && docker rm <name>`. |
| staged release images | `staged_release_images` | `!` | Whether images the release pins are staged on the controller by their lock digest, not by name, so pinned nodes accept them. | `noo cluster sync-images --stage-only --lock`. |
| system credentials | `system_credentials` | `!`, `x` | Whether every enabled system (such as evolve or trellion) has its credentials stored, so the next restart does not crash-loop the gateway. | `noo systems enable <system>`. |
| tailnet policy | `tailnet_policy` | `!`, `x` | Whether the live tailnet access policy contains everything noomesh declares (your own extra rules are not judged). | `noo security tailnet policy --merge` adds only what is missing. |
| tailscale ssh | `tailscale_ssh` | `!` | Whether any mesh device advertises Tailscale SSH, which noomesh never uses. | On each named box run `sudo tailscale set --ssh=false`. |
| tempo | `tempo` | `!`, `x` | Whether the gateway sends request traces to Tempo and Tempo answers /ready. | `noo security pki issue-service tempo` then `noo stack restart --force tempo`, or `noo upgrade --stack`. |
| tempo at rest | `tempo_at_rest` | `!`, accepted | Whether Tempo's data directory (request traces) sits on an encrypted disk. | The disk holding it is encrypted (dm-crypt/LUKS); or record the accepted risk with `noo security at-rest opt-out` (the row then reads accepted). |
| tempo listener | `tempo_listener` | `!`, `x` | Whether Tempo requires a client certificate on both doors, keeps gRPC on loopback, has usage reporting off and publishes no port. | `noo upgrade --stack` restores the shipped config. |
| undeclared containers | `undeclared_containers` | `!` | Whether containers are running that no compose file of this install declares. | `docker rm -f <names>` as printed; if docker is down, `sudo systemctl start docker`. |
| vendor CLIs | `vendor_clis` | OK only | Informational: lists nodes carrying a third-party vendor CLI that is only checked against a hash this controller pinned, not release-signed. | Nothing to clear; informational. |
| voice images | `voice_images` | `!`, `x` | Whether the voice containers (whisper, piper) run as non-root and can read their keys. | `noo upgrade --stack`, or `noo security pki fix-modes` for key access. |
| voice listeners | `voice_listeners` | `!`, `x` | Whether the voice doors (whisper, piper) require a cluster client certificate, refuse plain HTTP and publish no host port. | `noo upgrade --stack` restores the shipped overlay, then `noo stack restart --force whisper piper`. |
| voice models | `voice_models` | `!`, `x` | Whether the voice models are staged and the voice containers run offline. | `noo models pull <model>` for a missing model; `noo upgrade --stack` for an online container. |

## `noo security at-rest preflight-firmware` rows

| Row | id | Can be | Means | Clears when |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| firmware TPM reset | `firmware_tpm_reset` | `!` | Warns, on AMD machines, that a BIOS update can reset the firmware TPM and leave only the recovery key able to open the volume. | Informational; keep the recovery key at hand and run `noo security at-rest reenroll` after the update. Always OK on non-AMD CPUs. |
| fresh backup | `fresh_backup` | `!`, `x` | Whether a recent backup (under 24 hours old) exists in case the encrypted volume cannot be unlocked after a firmware update. | Make a fresh backup (`scripts/backup-controller.sh`); `noo backups status` shows what exists. |
| recovery key | `recovery_key` | `!`, `x` | Whether the encrypted volume has a recovery key that someone confirmed storing off this machine. | Run `noo security at-rest recovery-key`, store the key off the machine and acknowledge it. |
| Secure Boot database update | `secure_boot_database_update` | `!` | Warns that a firmware update of the Secure Boot database will change the volume's TPM lock and stop it unlocking until re-enrolled. | Informational before the update; afterwards run `noo security at-rest reenroll`. OK when the volume is TPM-only (not bound to Secure Boot). |
| TPM binding | `tpm_binding` | `!` | Whether the encrypted volume's TPM lock matches Secure Boot as it is now, so it will still unlock at the next boot. | Turn Secure Boot back on, or run `noo security at-rest reenroll`. |
| volume | `volume` | OK only | Names the encrypted state volume and its TPM policy; says nothing is at risk when no encrypted volume exists. | Always OK; informational. |
